result.summary: The food delivery home screen appears largely well-formed. Carousels and the bottom-clipped card are expected behavior. No clear visual defects such as overlapping text, misaligned elements, broken images, or truncated labels were found; only minor cosmetic observations.

issues.description: The pizza card's -20% badge and the ramen card's '€0 delivery' badge use slightly different vertical padding/positions relative to their card corners, giving inconsistent badge alignment between cards.
issues.suggestion: Use a shared badge component with identical offset and padding across all popular cards.
